retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition collage juxtaposing gritty street elements with modern luxury architecture using a central vertical anchor.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex digital composite featuring a central squatting figure in street attire, flanked by two distinct environments: a gritty street scene with a vintage car on the left, and a modern luxury home on the right, separated by a vertical wooden pole.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure acts as the bridge between two socioeconomic environments
Vertical wooden pole serves as a hard compositional divider
High-contrast lighting on the central subject against desaturated backgrounds
Scale shift between the large foreground subject and the smaller background figures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central foreground subject in a squatting pose, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A vertical wooden utility pole bisecting the image slightly off-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure's face, moves up the vertical pole, then scans left to the car and right to the house and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with environmental details and textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grays and browns in the background environments.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red from the vintage car and warm skin tones of the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and bold red for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject and car; low saturation/high contrast on the architectural elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and heavy block slabs
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-condensed, tall vertical proportions
Secondary text uses heavy, wide slab-serif with stencil-like cuts
Tertiary text uses a clean, modern sans-serif in a contrasting color
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stencil-style gaps in the blocky secondary text
Tight kerning to create a solid wall of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Juxtaposition of tall, thin condensed fonts with short, heavy block fonts.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom corner
Small circular logo in bottom left
Hanging shoes on a wire in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical impact and condensed feel
Matches the gritty, industrial feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen urban collage. Left side: a red vintage 1970s coupe with large chrome rims on a gritty street. Right side: a modern luxury glass and wood house at dusk. A vertical wooden pole separates them. In the center foreground, a man with dreadlocks in a squatting pose, wearing a white tank top and cargo pants.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the top right quadrant. Below it, add a smaller red sans-serif word. On the left side, over the car, add blocky, stenciled white text.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear vertical divide between the two backgrounds?
Is the typography condensed and bold?
Is the color palette gritty and high-contrast?

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of disparate photographic elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic lighting on the central subject relative to both backgrounds
Ensure the vertical pole acts as a clean compositional anchor
Verify the typography is legible against the complex background
Confirm the 'street vs luxury' theme is visually evident
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject + vertical divider + (Gritty Environment A | Luxury Environment B) + Condensed Display Typography
